title: contract_swap (request)
description: Point an installed contract at another executable already in the ledger, as an on-chain upgrade would (#539): only the instance's executable changes, its storage and TTL are kept, no constructor runs. A CAP-85 instance needs a mode.

version.description: Wire protocol version; checked on every message

wasm_hash.description: Hash of an already installed executable

layer.description: Where the rewritten entry goes: session (default; undone by ledger_rollback) or override (beneath the session; refused if the session already wrote the entry)

mode.description: Required for a CAP-85 instance: instance repoints this contract at the WASM, ref replaces the reference's target for every contract sharing it

version.description: Wire protocol version; checked on every message

id.description: Echoes the id of the contract_swap request
